primitives.name: casual_hand_on_hip
primitives.description: Left hand on left hip (hip_L affordance), right arm rests at side. Slight head turn + spine twist for casual confidence.

primitives.name: confident_both_hips
primitives.description: Both hands on hips — the classic 'power pose' or assertive stance.

primitives.name: emphatic_fist_chest
primitives.description: Right hand as fist near chest. Emphasis gesture — heartfelt sincerity, conviction, or 'I promise'.

primitives.name: hands_clasped_front
primitives.description: Both hands clasped low in front (clasp_low_front affordances). Polite/formal listening pose.

primitives.name: idle_arms_crossed
primitives.description: Both arms crossed in front. Reads as closed/defensive in some contexts, contemplative in others.

primitives.name: idle_hands_behind
primitives.description: Both hands behind back (parade rest / at-ease). Formal listening posture.

primitives.name: idle_natural
primitives.description: Baseline natural standing pose — arms at sides, head level. The primitive that applying does nothing extra beyond the avatar's authored natural pose.

primitives.name: making_a_point
primitives.description: Right hand index finger raised — 'one more thing', 'wait', 'pay attention'.

primitives.name: palms_open_low
primitives.description: Both hands held low in front, palms partially open. Reads as 'here it is' / open + non-threatening.

primitives.name: salute
primitives.description: Right hand salute to forehead — formal greeting or sign of respect.

primitives.name: stomach_hold
primitives.description: Right hand resting on stomach — comforting self-touch or nervous holding.

primitives.name: thoughtful_chin_touch
primitives.description: Right hand at chin (chin_R affordance), left arm rests at side. Head pitched slightly down + spine subtle lean.
